source: Generated original game art; architecture-only concert props. Refined to match the modern Sydney Opera House Concert Hall reference.
styleReference: Modern honey beech acoustic ribs, unornamented silver pipe organ, plain timber/brass gallery rails, simple red upholstery, flush timber exit doors, pink acoustic petals. Replaces the initial baroque/gilded prop treatment.
packing: Four columns by two rows, in sprites manifest order. Alpha values 0–16 discarded to remove colored matte; tight cutouts fitted into the unchanged frame dimensions with six-pixel transparent gutters.
